import { Head } from "@warlock.js/web";

export default function Root({ children }: { children: unknown }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <meta charSet="utf-8" />
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
        <Head />
      </head>
      <body>{children as never}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
